brief: Implement repo/billing/core.py (classes Billing, BillingError) so the usage->billing path is lossless, tenant-isolated, correctly priced, and auditable. The public API names are fixed. Each work package names the exact requirements it must satisfy.

work_packages.title: Ingest & store (dedup, reject-negative)
work_packages.instructions: Implement ingest(...) and usage_for(...). Record events; dedup by (tenant_id, request_id) as a no-op; reject a negative quantity with BillingError. Requirements: R1, R2, R12.

work_packages.title: Append-only ingest audit
work_packages.instructions: Append a 'usage.ingested' audit entry on every accepted ingest; expose audit_log as an immutable tuple. Requirement: R3.

work_packages.title: Tenant-isolated metering
work_packages.instructions: Implement usage_for(tenant) (only that tenant's events) and metered(tenant, metric) (summed deduped quantity). Requirements: R4, R5.

work_packages.title: Tiered pricing, minimum, rounding
work_packages.instructions: Implement pricing in issue_invoice: tiered (first 1000 units @ $0.01, the rest @ $0.008), a $5.00 minimum total, and all amounts rounded to 2 decimals. Returns {id, tenant_id, lines: {metric: {qty, amount}}, total}. Requirements: R6, R7, R8.

work_packages.title: Idempotent issuance
work_packages.instructions: Make issue_invoice idempotent: freeze the invoice on first issue; re-issuing returns the same id and totals. Requirement: R9.

work_packages.title: Reconciliation drift
work_packages.instructions: Implement reconcile(tenant): the drift between the issued invoice's per-metric quantities and current metered usage; 0.0 when consistent. Requirement: R10.

work_packages.title: Audit on issuance
work_packages.instructions: Append an 'invoice.issued' audit entry when an invoice is issued. Requirement: R11.
